Consent to lighting does not grant screen inspection, camera, or computer-control access. Each source skill directory contains only SKILL.md; retain repository-root LICENSE when extracting or redistributing. The Lamp/HAL runtime is a separate integration, not supplied by installing a skill directory.

download.label: Download
download.note: Full pinned repository archive. Install only the named skill with its required resources and applicable license; follow upstream setup.

recreate_locally.label: Recreate locally
recreate_locally.note: No separately authored and validated recreation brief is supplied for this upstream skill.

evidence.subject: source
evidence.environment: Public GitHub source reads and unauthenticated archive downloads; Python standard-library SHA-256 and Git-blob verification.
evidence.scope: Confirmed public pinned source, exact skill and license bytes, archive SHA-256, and documented requirements. No skill execution or model-compatibility test.

model_compatibility.note: Upstream host requirements are documented. This catalog has not run a consuming-model compatibility evaluation.
